questions.question: How long did the rain fall during Noah's flood?
questions.explanation: The rain fell for forty days and forty nights.

questions.question: Who led Israel across the Jordan River into the Promised Land?
questions.explanation: Moses died before Israel entered the land, and Joshua took over as leader.

questions.question: What did God give Moses on Mount Sinai?
questions.explanation: God gave Moses the two tablets of the law.

questions.question: Which giant did young David defeat with a sling and a stone?
questions.explanation: David trusted God and defeated Goliath of Gath.

questions.question: Who was thrown into the lions' den for praying to God?
questions.explanation: Daniel kept praying and God shut the mouths of the lions.

questions.question: Which prophet was swallowed by a great fish?
questions.explanation: Jonah ran from God's command and was swallowed by a great fish.

questions.question: What was the first of the ten plagues on Egypt?
questions.explanation: The Nile turned to blood as the first plague.

questions.question: Who was sold into slavery by his brothers and later became a ruler in Egypt?
questions.explanation: God used Joseph's story to save his family from famine.

questions.question: Which queen risked her life to save the Jewish people from Haman's plot?
questions.explanation: Esther approached the king uninvited to plead for her people.

questions.question: How many books are in the Old Testament?
questions.explanation: The Bible has 39 Old Testament books and 27 New Testament books.

questions.question: In which town was Jesus born?
questions.explanation: Jesus was born in Bethlehem, as the prophet Micah foretold.

questions.question: Who baptized Jesus in the Jordan River?
questions.explanation: John baptized Jesus, and the Spirit descended like a dove.

questions.question: How many disciples did Jesus choose to be closest to Him?
questions.explanation: Jesus called twelve disciples to follow Him.

questions.question: Which disciple betrayed Jesus?
questions.explanation: Judas betrayed Jesus to the authorities for thirty pieces of silver.

questions.question: On which day after His death did Jesus rise from the grave?
questions.explanation: Jesus rose on the third day, as He had promised.

questions.question: What is the name of the event when the Holy Spirit filled the believers in Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: At Pentecost the Spirit came and the church was empowered.

questions.question: Who was the first Christian martyr?
questions.explanation: Stephen was killed for his faith while praying for those who stoned him.

questions.question: Who wrote about half of the New Testament, including Romans and Philippians?
questions.explanation: Paul wrote thirteen New Testament letters.

questions.question: What is the last book of the Bible?
questions.explanation: Revelation ends the Bible with a vision of the new heaven and new earth.

questions.question: Who was struck by a bright light on the road to Damascus and became an apostle?
questions.explanation: Jesus appeared to Saul, who became Paul, the great missionary.

questions.question: Who built the ark?
questions.explanation: God told Noah to build an ark to save his family and the animals.

questions.question: Who is often called the father of faith, called by God to leave his homeland?
questions.explanation: Abraham trusted God's promise and left for a land God would show him.

questions.question: Who was Moses' brother who helped speak for him?
questions.explanation: God sent Aaron to help Moses before Pharaoh.

questions.question: Which king asked God for wisdom instead of riches?
questions.explanation: God was pleased with Solomon's request and gave him wisdom and more.

questions.question: Who was Ruth's mother-in-law?
questions.explanation: Ruth stayed loyal to Naomi and followed her to Bethlehem.

questions.question: Which disciple denied Jesus three times?
questions.explanation: Peter denied knowing Jesus, wept, and was later restored.

questions.question: Which short tax collector climbed a sycamore tree to see Jesus?
questions.explanation: Jesus visited Zacchaeus' house, and his life changed.

questions.question: Who was Paul's young friend and student to whom he wrote two letters?
questions.explanation: Paul wrote 1 and 2 Timothy to encourage him in ministry.

questions.question: Who was the mother of Jesus?
questions.explanation: An angel told Mary she would bear the Son of God.

questions.question: Which prophet was taken up to heaven in a whirlwind with a chariot of fire?
questions.explanation: Elijah did not die; God took him up to heaven.

questions.question: What is the first book of the Bible?
questions.explanation: Genesis means beginnings.

questions.question: Which book is a collection of songs and prayers?
questions.explanation: The Psalms have 150 songs and prayers.

questions.question: Which book tells how God rescued Israel from slavery in Egypt?
questions.explanation: Exodus means exit or departure.

questions.question: Which Gospel was written by Luke, a doctor and Paul's companion?
questions.explanation: Luke also wrote the book of Acts.

questions.question: Which king is credited with writing much of the book of Proverbs?
questions.explanation: Solomon wrote many of the proverbs, and others were added by wise men.

questions.question: Which book comes right after the four Gospels?
questions.explanation: Acts tells the story of the early church.

questions.question: How many books are in the New Testament?
questions.explanation: There are 27 New Testament books and 39 Old Testament books.

questions.question: Which Old Testament book follows a man who lost everything but stayed faithful to God?
questions.explanation: Job suffers deeply yet keeps trusting God.

questions.question: Which chapter in 1 Corinthians is known as the love chapter?
questions.explanation: It describes what real love looks like.

questions.question: Which Gospel begins with the line 'In the beginning was the Word'?
questions.explanation: John begins by showing that Jesus is God and was with God from the start.

questions.question: What was Jesus' first recorded miracle?
questions.explanation: Jesus performed this sign at a wedding in Cana.

questions.question: How many loaves and fish did Jesus use to feed the 5,000?
questions.explanation: A boy's small lunch fed thousands.

questions.question: Who did Jesus raise from the dead after four days in the tomb?
questions.explanation: Jesus called Lazarus out of the tomb.

questions.question: What famous prayer did Jesus teach His disciples?
questions.explanation: It begins 'Our Father in heaven.'

questions.question: What is Jesus' famous teaching that begins 'Blessed are the poor in spirit' called?
questions.explanation: The Beatitudes open the Sermon on the Mount.

questions.question: What did Jesus call the greatest commandment?
options: Love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, and mind
questions.explanation: He added that the second is to love your neighbor as yourself.

questions.question: What animal did Jesus ride into Jerusalem on Palm Sunday?
questions.explanation: People laid palm branches and cloaks on the road.

questions.question: How many days did Jesus fast in the wilderness before being tempted?
questions.explanation: Jesus fasted forty days and nights, and answered every temptation with Scripture.

questions.question: Which woman is recorded as seeing the risen Jesus at the tomb?
questions.explanation: Jesus appeared to Mary and sent her to tell the disciples.

questions.question: Which parable tells of a son who left home, wasted everything, and was welcomed back by his father?
questions.explanation: It shows the Father's forgiving love.

questions.question: Complete John 3:16: 'For God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten ____'
questions.explanation: Jesus is the gift of God's love.

questions.question: Complete Psalm 23:1: 'The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not ____'
questions.explanation: God provides everything we need.

questions.question: Complete Philippians 4:13: 'I can do all things through ____ which strengtheneth me.'
questions.explanation: Our strength comes from Christ.

questions.question: Complete Romans 8:28: 'all things work together for ____ to them that love God.'
questions.explanation: God works through everything for the good of those who love Him.

questions.question: Complete Proverbs 3:5: 'Trust in the LORD with all thine ____'
questions.explanation: Trusting God starts with the heart.

questions.question: Complete Matthew 6:33: 'Seek ye first the kingdom of God, and his ____'
questions.explanation: Putting God first lets other things fall into place.

questions.question: Complete Psalm 46:10: 'Be still, and know that I am ____'
questions.explanation: Stillness helps us remember who God is.

questions.question: Complete Isaiah 40:31: 'they that wait upon the LORD shall renew their ____'
questions.explanation: Waiting on God brings new strength.

questions.question: Complete Ephesians 2:8: 'For by grace are ye saved through ____'
questions.explanation: Salvation is God's gift received by faith.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT listed as a fruit of the Spirit?
questions.explanation: The fruit of the Spirit includes love, joy, peace, gentleness, and more. Pride is not on the list.
